newsitem.title: USA: Pallet Management sets 2-for-1 stock split.
newsitem.headline: Pallet Management sets 2-for-1 stock split.

text.p: Pallet Management Systems Inc said on Friday it has set a two-for-one stock split effective for shareholders of record on October 3.
It is to be paid out on November 15.

Before the split was declared, certain inside shareholders who hold more than 75 percent of the outstanding shares had waived their rights to receive any additional shares by way of the stock splits during the 1996 calendar year, the company said.
